required_artifacts.description: Canonical crawl dataset compatible with doubao-crawler-web/v1.
Question -> sample -> share link registry with asked/completed/fetched timestamps.
One row per sample with the full parsed record: answer, brief, suggest questions, search blocks, references, timing, raw/log paths.
Question -> public thread share link workbook with 分享链接 and 按问题汇总 sheets.
Machine-readable metrics, including mobile_evidence when Android/Appium data is present.
Structured Markdown export for review and handoff.
Structured Excel workbook matching the Markdown tables.
